integrationTestEvidence: Actual current workflow shell invokes real summary writer, real status collector and real new extractor in order. Success requires summary -> test cases -> one exact dedicated attachment export, source_verified status JSON, complete receipt and seven fixed files with exact bytes.
Negative flows prove missing/incomplete case evidence cannot export binaries; no swallowed missing-script error is accepted as success.

Mutation controls cover manifest identities/hashes/names/byte caps, raw metadata identities, archive/member restrictions, export paths/types/symlinks, own-process timeout, changed source, staged write failure and interruption.
